hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .file_path // .path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$FILE" ] || ! echo "$FILE" | grep -q "\.go$"; then exit 0; fi; gofumpt -w "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; golangci-lint run --fast-only --fix "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; REMAINING=$(golangci-lint run --fast-only "$FILE" 2>&1 || true); if [ -n "$REMAINING" ] && echo "$REMAINING" | grep -qE ":[0-9]+:[0-9]+:"; then jq -nc --arg ctx "golangci-lint reports unresolved issues in $FILE after --fix:\n$REMAINING" '\''{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$ctx}}'\''; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".file_path // .path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(\.golangci\.ya?ml|cspell\.json|\.markdownlint\.json)$"; then echo "BLOCKED: リンター設定ファイルは直接編集禁止。コードを修正してリンターエラーを解消してください。"; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .file_path // .path // empty"); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(^|/)\.env($|\.)|\.key$|kubeconfig$|_rsa$"; then echo "BLOCKED: secret/credential file edits forbidden ($FILE)" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'CMD=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm[[:space:]]+-rf?[[:space:]]+(/|~|\*)"; then echo "BLOCKED: destructive rm -rf root" >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+push.*--force.*(main|master)|git[[:space:]]+push.*(main|master).*--force"; then echo "BLOCKED: force-push to main/master" >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "--no-verify\b"; then echo "BLOCKED: --no-verify forbidden" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'cd /Users/nosawakazuma/Project/Fishing-api && OUT=$( { go build ./... && go test ./... -short -count=1; } 2>&1); RC=$?; OUT="${OUT:0:4000}"; if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then jq -nc --arg ctx "Stop hook: build/test failed (truncated to 4KB):\n$OUT" '\''{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"Stop",additionalContext:$ctx}}'\''; fi; exit 0'
